newsitem.title: UK: Brother of British mass murderer hangs himself.
newsitem.headline: Brother of British mass murderer hangs himself.

text.p: The brother of mass murderer Fred West apparently hanged himself on Thursday in a macabre echo of the serial killer's own suicide.

John West was found hanging from a beam in his garage shortly before the end of his trial for raping his niece, who told a court she was attacked over 300 times by her uncle. He was on bail at the time of his death.
Police said there were no suspicious circumstances surrounding the death of the 54-year-old retired dustman.
Fred West hanged himself in jail on New Year's Day 1995 while awaiting trial on charges of murdering 12 young women and girls.

His wife Rosemary was later sentenced to life imprisonment for 10 murders in the "House of Horrors" they shared in a suburban back street in the western English town of Gloucester. The victims included one of her own daughters.
Fred West had tried to implicate his brother in the killings but the judge in John's trial told the jury there was no suggestion he was involved in the killings.

But Detective Superintendent John Bennett, who led the inquiry into the murders, said John West's death was not the final chapter. Inquiries are still going on "but it would not be right for me to comment on those for operational reasons."
Anne Marie West, now aged 32, told a court how John West would visit the house two or three times a week and rape her in the bathroom. The attacks began when she was only 10-years-old, she said.
She said been sexually abused so often by her parents that she had no idea that what her uncle was doing was wrong.
John's only surviving brother, Doug, told reporters: "It is unbelievable that John has done this -- just like Fred did. We have spent the last two years trying to rebuild our lives and now this."
